title: Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC)
summary: Lets an application use a Lightning wallet through Nostr relays: a nostr+walletconnect:// connection string, an info event (kind 13194), requests (kind 23194) and responses (kind 23195) encrypted with NIP-44 (NIP-04 only for backward compatibility), and methods such as pay_invoice, make_invoice, lookup_invoice, get_balance and get_info; further methods are defined in extension specifications.
relevance: How wallet services such as Alby Hub are reached by applications; BTCortex does not offer NWC today.
